sources.title: Portable AI USB: A Full AI Assistant on a Flash Drive, No Internet Required
sources.snippet: Portable AI USB proves it — a fully offline AI assistant that runs entirely from a USB flash drive, on any operating system, leaving zero trace on the host machine. What It Actually Is Portable AI USB bundles two proven open-source tools — Ollama for model inference and AnythingLLM for the chat interface — onto an exFAT-formatted USB drive.

sources.title: Aion 1.0: Microsoft's On-Device AI Models for Windows (2026)
sources.snippet: Microsoft announced the Aion 1.0 model family at Build 2026 — small AI models designed to run directly on Windows devices without cloud API calls. Two variants: Aion 1.0 Instruct (reasoning and instruction following) and Aion 1.0 Plan (planning, tool use, and agent workflows).
